title: Download a file from the internet using curl
summary: Use curl to download a file and save it with its original name. This is useful for grabbing files directly from a URL without opening a browser.

aliases.text: загрузить файл из интернета в терминале

steps.explain: Use the -O flag to tell curl to save the downloaded content to a file named after the last part of the URL.

placeholders.name: URL
placeholders.description: The full URL of the file to download
